I1: All selected leaf names and both control entries require descriptor-relative lstat absence before launch. Existing parent types and identities are checked. Enumeration errors propagate and all inventoried directories must be visited.
I2: Stage and runtime open independently from / with no-follow directory descriptors. The installer remembers observed (device,inode) pairs for directories, rechecks original root names, creates missing parent components relative to a held descriptor, and exclusively opens each new leaf with O_NOFOLLOW. Stops preserve existing and partial evidence.
cases: preexisting selected directory, regular target, regular launch and dangling control entries
non-directory parent and exact zero-extra namespace
actual unreadable subtree under unprivileged uid
replacement of bound runtime root or previously scanned parent and exclusive leaf collision after preflight
successful fixture restore into new/existing parents, successful read-only verify, damaged verify no writes
pin_constants_check: AST literal equality of original and final capsule, manifest, original snapshot, old guard pins and logical digest.
limitations: Restore/verify ran on temporary tiny fixtures. Capsule unpacking and snapshot selection were substituted for those fixture tests. No live installation, runtime compatibility decision or formal proof execution. Shared directory-descriptor checks protect the checked directories and exclusive creates, without attempting to prevent arbitrary uncooperative concurrent writers.
